chunks: Whenever he is told: 'Obey God,' his arrogance leads him to more sin; and sufficient for him shall be Hell: How evil a place of wide expanse!

key_terms.الْمِهَادُ: A place of rest or dwelling

ai.seo_question: What is the consequence for the arrogant person who rejects the command to fear God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to illustrate the spiritual blindness of the arrogant, whose ego (izzah) overrides divine command, leading to a self-imposed descent into Hell. The phrase 'sufficient for him is Hell' emphasizes that his own pride constitutes his punishment, a theme resonating with the concept of self-destruction through disobedience. This characterization aligns with the description of the hypocrites and the proud in the Quranic narrative of creation.
